messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Triplet: ["gabapentin", "starts working for pain", "after 1 week in some people"]

The relation 'starts working for pain' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may begin to alleviate pain in some individuals after the time period specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has onset of effect': The subject drug starts to work or shows its effect within the time period specified by the object entity.
B. 'increases risk of': Taking the subject drug may raise the patient's likelihood of experiencing the condition or event specified by the object entity.
C. 'has duration of treatment': The subject drug is typically taken for the length of time specified by the object entity.
D. 'mimics symptoms of': The subject condition or drug may present symptoms that resemble those of the medical condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'used in population': The subject drug is used in or approved for the patient population or age group specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
